design.design: prospective descriptive reference comparison, not accuracy validation
known_prior_exposure: Existing preliminary UN mudflow/rockflow mapping and NASA GLC were viewed in earlier implementations; those cannot be called blinded references.
Existing radar observations, NASADEM and Phase 3 control diagnostics are known. No new OPERA/HLS reference catalog or image has been examined.
design.spatial_use: No buffer is applied to measured intersection area; tolerance is disclosed for geolocation differences. Pixel-center inclusion for reference cells.
design.sensor_difference: NISAR L-band vs Sentinel-1 C-band or HLS optical; different scattering/cloud sensitivity.
design.matching: Choose closest eligible reference in tolerance, then lowest cloud where available, then lexicographic ID, without inspecting response values.
design.holdout_policy: No reference value can select thresholds, tune rules, pick footprints, or change input baselines. Negative/mixed results retained.
design.limitations: No random/exhaustive truth sample or validated stable/unmapped labels; descriptive overlap only.

profile.interpretation: Mean filtered log-backscatter on a fixed common-valid footprint. dB differences are not ground displacement. No cause or calibrated confidence is inferred.
profile.cpr_definition: HV_dB - HH_dB on the existing fixed common-valid footprint. Difference of filtered log-powers, not a polarimetric decomposition or ratio of spatial mean powers.
profile.label: Frozen reference: target geographic
profile.selection: Frozen before new reference inspection; role labels are not verified event/stability truth.

reference_definition: HLS Fmask water on eligible optical pixels; independent algorithmic context, not OPERA DSWx or ground truth.
qa_policy: Exclude fill, cloud, cloud adjacency, shadow, snow and cirrus/reserved low bits; aerosol bits are retained, not a separate exclusion.
limitations: Geographic comparison roles are not independently verified stable/unaffected labels.
No accuracy metrics or physical cause are inferred; no threshold tuning after reference inspection.
Only clear reference pixel centers with finite nearest-grid HH/HV enter overlap; partial coverage is explicit.
Native radar footprint means and reference-grid overlap use different sampling grids.
OPERA DSWx and DIST catalogs are screened only; no OPERA reference raster is accepted in this version.
